stem.en:
The line graph shows the average number of visitors per day at the outdoor pool and the indoor pool in Lakeview, a small town, from April to September 2025. (The town and all figures are invented for practice.)

Data shown in the graph (average visitors per day):
Month | Apr | May | Jun | Jul | Aug | Sep
Outdoor pool | 40 | 120 | 380 | 520 | 470 | 150
Indoor pool | 210 | 190 | 150 | 130 | 140 | 200

Describe the main features of the information and make comparisons where they are useful.

why.en: Band 5 answers list numbers one by one. Begin with an overview: the outdoor pool peaked in July, while the indoor pool was quietest then.
why.uz: 5-ball javoblar raqamlarni birma-bir sanaydi. Umumiy xulosadan boshlang: ochiq basseyn iyulda eng gavjum boʻlgan, yopiq basseyn esa aynan oʻshanda eng boʻsh.
why.ru: Ответы на 5 баллов перечисляют цифры по одной. Начните с обзора: открытый бассейн был полнее всего в июле, а крытый тогда пустовал больше всего.

The line graph shows the percentage of students at Riverside College who travelled to college by bus, by car and by bicycle between 2005 and 2025. Other ways of travelling, such as walking, are not shown. (The college and all figures are invented for practice.)

Data shown in the graph (% of students):
Year | 2005 | 2010 | 2015 | 2020 | 2025
Bus | 52 | 48 | 41 | 35 | 30
Car | 25 | 30 | 33 | 31 | 27
Bicycle | 8 | 10 | 15 | 22 | 28

Describe the main features of the information and make comparisons where they are useful.

why.en: Band 6 needs a relevant overview. Group the lines: the bus fell steadily, cycling rose fast, the car rose and then fell. Support each with figures.
why.uz: 6-ball uchun mos umumiy xulosa kerak. Chiziqlarni guruhlang: avtobus tinmay kamaygan, velosiped tez oshgan, mashina avval oshib, soʻng kamaygan. Raqamlar bilan asoslang.
why.ru: Для 6 баллов нужен уместный обзор. Сгруппируйте линии: автобус стабильно падал, велосипед быстро рос, машина сначала росла, потом падала. Дайте цифры.

The line graph shows how much electricity was produced from coal, gas, wind and solar power in Northland, a country, between 2000 and 2025. (The country and all figures are invented for practice.)

Data shown in the graph (terawatt-hours per year):
Year | 2000 | 2005 | 2010 | 2015 | 2020 | 2025
Coal | 60 | 58 | 50 | 38 | 25 | 15
Gas | 20 | 28 | 35 | 40 | 38 | 33
Wind | 1 | 4 | 10 | 18 | 30 | 42
Solar | 0 | 0 | 2 | 8 | 17 | 29

Describe the main features of the information and make comparisons where they are useful.

why.en: Band 7 asks for a clear overview with the data grouped. Compare fossil fuels with renewables, note that the total rose, and say when wind overtook coal.
why.uz: 7-ball aniq umumiy xulosa va guruhlangan maʼlumotni talab qiladi. Koʻmir va gazni qayta tiklanuvchi manbalar bilan solishtiring, jami oshganini va shamol koʻmirdan qachon oʻtganini ayting.

The bar chart shows how many hours a week boys and girls in Year 9 at Hillside School spent, on average, on five activities in 2025. (The school and all figures are invented for practice.)

Data shown in the chart (average hours per week):
Activity | Boys | Girls
Homework | 8 | 9
Sport | 6 | 4
Video games | 7 | 3
Reading for fun | 2 | 4
Helping at home | 3 | 5

Describe the main features of the information and make comparisons where they are useful.

why.en: Compare, don't just list: say which activities took more of the boys' time and which more of the girls', then give the biggest gap (video games).
why.uz: Faqat sanab chiqmang, taqqoslang: qaysi mashgʻulotga oʻgʻil bolalar, qaysisiga qizlar koʻproq vaqt sarflaganini ayting, keyin eng katta farqni (video oʻyinlar) bering.
why.ru: Не перечисляйте, а сравнивайте: на что больше времени тратили мальчики, на что — девочки, и назовите самый большой разрыв (видеоигры).

The bar chart shows the main source of news for people in four age groups in Westland, a country, in 2025. Other sources are not shown, so the bars for each group do not add up to 100%. (The country and all figures are invented for practice.)

Data shown in the chart (% of each age group):
Age group | Television | News websites | Social media | Printed newspapers
16-24 | 10 | 18 | 62 | 2
25-44 | 22 | 34 | 38 | 3
45-64 | 45 | 30 | 15 | 7
65 and over | 63 | 12 | 6 | 16

Describe the main features of the information and make comparisons where they are useful.

why.en: Do not describe all 16 bars. Show the age pattern: social media leads under 45, television from 45 up. Pick a few figures that prove it.
why.uz: 16 ta ustunning hammasini tasvirlamang. Yosh boʻyicha qonuniyatni koʻrsating: 45 yoshgacha ijtimoiy tarmoqlar, 45 yoshdan keyin televizor yetakchi. Buni isbotlovchi bir necha raqam tanlang.
why.ru: Не описывайте все 16 столбцов. Покажите закономерность по возрасту: до 45 лет лидируют соцсети, с 45 — телевидение. Выберите несколько цифр-доказательств.

Type of event | 2023 | 2024 | 2025
Concerts | 4,200 | 4,600 | 5,300
Plays | 3,100 | 2,900 | 2,500
Film nights | 1,800 | 2,400 | 3,600

Drinking and cooking | 8 / 8 | 7 / 8 | 6 / 7

stem.en:
The diagram shows how apple juice is made at Sunny Hill Farm. (The farm is invented for practice.)

Stages shown in the diagram:
1. Apples are picked by hand in autumn.
2. The apples are washed in cold water.
3. Workers sort the apples. Damaged apples are taken out and given to the farm animals.
4. A machine cuts and crushes the good apples into a pulp.
5. The pulp is pressed to squeeze out the juice. The dry pulp that is left goes to the compost heap.
6. The juice is heated for a short time so that it keeps longer.
7. The juice is poured into glass bottles, labelled and sold in the farm shop.

Describe the stages of the process.

why.en: A process has no trends. Give an overview (how many stages, where it starts and ends), then use sequence words and the passive: the apples are washed…
why.uz: Jarayonda tendensiya boʻlmaydi. Umumiy xulosa bering (nechta bosqich, qayerdan boshlanib, qayerda tugaydi), soʻng ketma-ketlik soʻzlari va majhul nisbatdan foydalaning.
why.ru: В процессе нет трендов. Дайте обзор (сколько этапов, с чего начинается и чем заканчивается), затем слова порядка и пассив: the apples are washed…

stem.en:
The diagram shows the rainwater system at Northfield School. (The school and its system are invented for practice.)

What the diagram shows:
1. Rain falls on the school roof.
2. Gutters along the edge of the roof collect the water and send it down a pipe.
3. A filter removes leaves and dirt.
4. The water is stored in an underground tank that holds 10,000 litres.
5. When the tank is full, extra water leaves through an overflow pipe to the street drain.
6. A pump lifts water from the tank to a small tank in the roof space.
7. From there, the water is used to flush the toilets and to water the school garden. It is not used for drinking.
8. When the underground tank is almost empty, the system switches to mains water automatically.

Describe how the system works.

why.en: Cover both branches, not only the main line: the overflow when the tank is full and the switch to mains water when it is almost empty.
why.uz: Faqat asosiy yoʻlni emas, ikkala tarmoqni ham yoriting: idish toʻlganda ortiqcha suv chiqib ketishini va u deyarli boʻshaganda vodoprovod suviga oʻtilishini.
why.ru: Опишите обе ветки, а не только основную линию: перелив, когда бак полон, и переход на водопровод, когда он почти пуст.

stem.en:
The diagram shows how Bramble Fuels, a company, turns used coffee grounds into fuel pellets. (The company and its process are invented for practice.)

Stages shown in the diagram:
1. Used coffee grounds are collected from cafés in sealed bins.
2. At the factory, the grounds are dried in a heated rotating drum until most of the water has gone.
3. In an extraction tank, oil is removed from the dried grounds. The oil is sold to soap makers.
4. The remaining grounds are mixed with a small amount of sawdust.
5. The mixture is pressed into small pellets.
6. The pellets are cooled and then sieved. Broken pieces are sent back to stage 5.
7. The finished pellets are packed in 10 kg bags and sold as fuel for home stoves.

Describe the process.

why.en: Band 7 needs a clear overview: one input, two products (pellets and oil) and one loop. Vary passives and linkers so the stages do not read like a list.
why.uz: 7-ball uchun aniq umumiy xulosa kerak: bitta xomashyo, ikkita mahsulot (pellet va moy) va bitta qaytish halqasi. Bosqichlar roʻyxatga oʻxshamasligi uchun majhul nisbat shakllari va bogʻlovchilarni almashtirib turing.
why.ru: Для 7 баллов нужен ясный обзор: одно сырьё, два продукта (гранулы и масло) и один возвратный цикл. Меняйте пассив и связки, чтобы этапы не звучали списком.

stem.en:
The two maps show Riverside Park in 2015 and in 2025. (The park is invented for practice.)

Map 1 (2015):
- A lake in the centre of the park, with a footpath around it.
- A large car park with 120 spaces at the north entrance.
- Open grass to the east of the lake.
- A small kiosk selling drinks near the south gate.
- A line of trees along the west side.

Map 2 (2025):
- The lake and the footpath are the same.
- The car park is half its old size (60 spaces). A playground is on the other half.
- A café with outdoor tables is on the grass east of the lake.
- The kiosk has gone.
- A new cycle path runs along the west side, next to the trees.

Describe the main changes between the two maps.

why.en: With two maps, describe the changes, not each place. Start with an overview: the park gained places for children and food, and the car park shrank.
why.uz: Ikki xaritada har bir joyni emas, oʻzgarishlarni tasvirlang. Umumiy xulosadan boshlang: bogʻda bolalar va ovqatlanish uchun joylar paydo boʻldi, avtoturargoh esa kichrayib qoldi.
why.ru: На двух картах описывайте изменения, а не каждое место. Начните с обзора: в парке появились места для детей и еды, а парковка уменьшилась.

stem.en:
The two maps show the village of Westbrook in 2000 and in 2025. (The village is invented for practice.)

Map 1 (2000):
- A main road runs from west to east through the village.
- Farmland covers the area north of the main road.
- A small shop and a post office stand in the centre, on the main road.
- A primary school is at the west end of the village.
- A river runs along the south side, with a footbridge across it.
- Fields lie along the river to the east.

Map 2 (2025):
- Most of the farmland north of the road has become a housing estate, reached by a new road with a roundabout where it meets the main road.
- A supermarket with a car park has replaced the shop and the post office.
- The primary school is larger and has a new sports field.
- A road bridge has replaced the footbridge.
- The fields along the river to the east are now a nature reserve.

Describe the main changes between the two maps.

why.en: Organise by area (north, centre, south) or by type of change. Use the passive for changes: the farmland was replaced by housing.
why.uz: Matnni hudud (shimol, markaz, janub) yoki oʻzgarish turi boʻyicha tartiblang. Oʻzgarishlar uchun majhul nisbatni ishlating: the farmland was replaced by housing.
why.ru: Стройте текст по зонам (север, центр, юг) или по типам изменений. Для изменений используйте пассив: the farmland was replaced by housing.

stem.en:
The two plans show the ground floor of Hollins Town Library today and a proposed new design. (The library and the plans are invented for practice.)

Plan 1 (today):
- The entrance is on the south side, with a reception desk to the right of it and toilets to the left.
- Rows of bookshelves fill the centre of the floor.
- The children's section is in the north-east corner.
- A small quiet reading room is in the north-west corner.
- Eight computers stand along the west wall.

Plan 2 (proposed):
- The entrance will move to the east side, facing a new bus stop.
- The reception desk will be replaced by self-service machines and a small help desk.
- The bookshelves will move to the walls, and the centre will become an open study area with 40 seats.
- The children's section will be larger and will move to the south side, where the old entrance was.
- A café will replace the reading room in the north-west corner.
- A digital room with 20 computers will be in the north-east corner.
- The toilets will stay where they are.

Describe the main differences between the two plans.

why.en: This is a plan for the future, so use 'will be' and 'is to be'. Overview: the floor becomes more open, with more space for study and computers.
why.uz: Bu kelajak rejasi, shuning uchun «will be» va «is to be» shakllaridan foydalaning. Umumiy xulosa: qavat ochiqroq boʻladi, oʻqish va kompyuterlar uchun joy koʻpayadi.
why.ru: Это план на будущее, поэтому используйте 'will be' и 'is to be'. Обзор: этаж станет открытее, места для учёбы и компьютеров станет больше.
